Not as good as it was
Jul 2019 • Solo
Becoming more of a girly bar with bar dancers quite regularly. I go there for a drink and to sit and chat with the girls. I’m happy to buy them drinks because that’s how they make a living and I have never been asked if I want sex. But I think the dancers will attract the sort of customer looking for sex.

The best bar in saigon
Apr 2019 • Solo
I love this bar. I have been to Saigon many times but only found voodoo after my favourite bar closed. Great bar with gorgeous girls that will talk and keep you company as long as you buy them a drink. They are not pushy and not after sex. They play great music from the 60’s to current and you can request a song. Also have a foosball table to challenge the girls (be warned they are very good).
The best waitress would have to be My. She is beautiful and she made me feel so welcome. I found myself at voodoo every night.

Great little watering hole
Aug 2016 • Friends
Always interesting to see reports like the one before this one, so as a bit of a counter..... Voodoo is always a place that I stop off in when I visit Saigon. Thoung has been running this place for the past 7 years (I think) and I always head there for a drink or three when I visit. Seeing a comment stating "girls in the bar are rude" is very surprising and annoying, as there is a regular clientele of people who always come back, and the ladies behind the bar are always very genuine. I'll certainly be back again and again as I know there will be no loading of bills, or other such problems that occur in some of the other establishments in town. Keep up the good work :-)

I quite like the place
Dec 2015 • Business
I come here once or twice a month when I'm in town. The girls are friendly and yes, sometimes pushy, but I've never had problems with the bill or otherwise. The owner is a really nice lady and she is happy to resolve problems when they arise. The key is to have fun and go with the flow. The food is pretty good and the selection of whiskys, single malt and blended are very, very good. I usually bring friends and they always have fun. Treat the girls with respect, have a little fun, and take it easy is the key.
